Accessibility testing and WCAG
basics
Accessibility testing combines automated checks and manual checks. WCAG organizes
guidance around perceivable, operable, understandable and robust content.
Accessibility test කරන්න tools විතරකේ ප්‍රිමාණවත් නුහු. Keyboard, focus, contrast සහ screen
Test a signup form using keyboard and a screen reader.
1 Perceivable →text alternatives · 2 Operable →keyboard · 3 Understandable →labels and errors · 4 Robust →valid semantics
Read the numbered stages from top to bottom. Perceivable → text alternatives; Robust → valid semantics.

<label for="email">Email address</label>
<input id="email" name="email" type="email" required>
<button type="submit">Register</button>
Expected result: A labeled native input and submit control; still requires manual testing.
Interview question: Can automated accessibility tests prove full compliance?
Answer: No. Many issues require human evaluation.
Practice: Check keyboard order, contrast, zoom and accessible names.
